title: Academic Staff Data Unavailable
message: A comprehensive, publicly accessible academic staff directory could not be located on ICBT's official website during data collection. As a result, academic staff coverage could not be independently verified, and the institution's academic profiles may be incomplete or unavailable. The few profiles shown here are not enough to compare ICBT with other institutions, so ICBT is not used in any comparison.

title: Academic Staff Coverage Unverified
message: KIU's official website provides information about its faculties and departments. However, a comprehensive, accessible academic staff directory could not be verified during data collection. Academic staff coverage may therefore be incomplete. The few profiles shown here are not enough to compare KIU with other institutions, so KIU is not used in any comparison.
source: Official institutional website (https://kiu.ac.lk/) · Website reviewed: October 2026
